finalResult.nextParagraphText: “No idea, but I’m fairly confident he wouldn’t disagree with whatever choice I make today. Contrary to you guys, he respects when something is not his choice to make,” Jake spoke, taking a not-so-subtle dig at not just the god but the entire Holy Church.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I don’t easily change my mind,” Jake simply responded.
